title: Open-Meteo geocoding — Crans-Montana, Valais, Switzerland
claims: Open-Meteo geocoding returns Crans-Montana, Valais, Switzerland at latitude 46.31316, longitude 7.47914, elevation 1,547 m.
The result is a town centroid, not the race start line or the finish area.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 调用 Open-Meteo geocoding API，取 Crans-Montana 的镇中心坐标作地图锚点。

claimVerification.note: feature_code 为 PPL（populated place），不是赛道起终点测量点
